a:r.a:t: Control of Carbohydrate Metabolism in the Liver

p:cNvPr.descr: An illustration of the regulation of carbohydrate metabolism in the liver. At the top is high blood glucose on a red horizontal line. It points left and down to [up arrow] insulin, and points right and down, with GLUT2 in the middle, to [up arrow][Glucose] inside. [up arrow] insuline points left and down to [up arrow] Insulin-sensitive protein kinase, right and down to [up arrow] PKB, and further right and down to synthesis of hexokinase II, PFK-1, pyruvate kinase. [up arrow] insulin-senstive protein kinase points down to [up arrow] PP1. [up arrow] PKB points down to [down arrow] GSK-3. [up arrow]PP1 points left and down to [down arrow] phosphorylase kinase, which points down and right to [down arrow] glycogen phosphorylase, as does [up arrow] PP1. [up arrow] PP1 and [down arrow] GSK-3 both point to [up arrow] glycgoen synthase. This is all in red. [down arrow] glycogen phosphorylase points down to a pink box with [down arrow] glycogen breakdown. [up arrow glycogen synthase and [up arrow] glucose inside both point to a pink box with [up arrow] glycogen synthesis. [up arrow] glucose inside and synthesis of hexokinase II, PFK-1, pyruvate kinase both point to a red box with [up arrow] glycolosysis. From the bottom of the image, in blue, it begins with low blood glucose, which points up to [up arrow] glucagon, which points up to [up arrow][cAMP], which points up to [up arrow]PKA. [up arrow] PKA points left and up to [up arrow] phosphorylase kinase, which points up to [up arrow] glycogen phosphorylase, which points up to a blue box with [up arrow] glycogen breakdown. [up arrow] PKA also points up to [down arrow] glycogen synthase, which points up to a blue box with [down arrow] glycogen synthesis. [up arrow] PKA also points right and up to [down arrow] pyruvate kinase L, which points up to [down arrow] glycoloysis, as well as pointing right and up to [up arrow FBPase-2 and [down arrow] PFK-2. These point up to [down arrow][F26BP], which points up to [down arrow] PFK-1, which points up to the blue box with [down arrow] glycolysis.
